description.value: Chilko River Lodge & Guest Ranch is a family-run wilderness retreat on the banks of the Chilko River in the Chilcotin, surrounded by Ts'ylos Provincial Park and the eastern foothills of the Coast Mountains. The property offers five log cabins with kitchenettes plus a main house, all accessed via gravel road from Tatla Lake, making it a genuinely remote destination. A licensed bar/restaurant serves home cooking on-site, and guests may encounter spawning salmon, grizzly bears, and bald eagles nearby.

No bike-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, though biking is listed among guest activities and the lodge operates a licensed bar/restaurant providing on-site evening food.
